title: [v0.4.x] Inspect: avoid false positives from comments and text
author: mcpdev80
body:
## Aufräumprüfung 15.10.2026

Am aktuellen develop `33b7ca94b42cc45e908c0d964cfbe0cc8349f231` ist die relevante Entscheidungslogik weiterhin vorhanden; kein Abschluss allein wegen des Alters oder alter Fix-Branches.

Vorhandene Vorarbeit vor Neuimplementierung prüfen:
- `fix/751-capability-import-noise-v0421` — `aabd82ff6cb7f6a55f33001638e51e53dfc7f2a8`

Diese Branches sind gegenüber develop divergiert; weder komplette Integration noch sichere Löschbarkeit ist durch Ancestry belegt. Kein pauschaler Merge/Rebase. Gezielt brauchbare Änderungen mit dem aktuellen Vertrag vergleichen. Keine neuen Tests in dieser Hygiene-Prüfung gestartet.

---

## Current triage — outstanding pre-freeze work

Milestone: **v0.4.x**; final semantic acceptance: #174. Original v0.4.20/v0.4.21/v0.4.24 references below describe the historical report, not proof of completion or a new release assignment.

The original risk remains visible in [capability_detection_runtime.go at `1b1ae323`](https://github.com/mcpdev80/baseharbor/blob/1b1ae323284d436f379777a3ab65b37072df14c3/internal/repositoryinspect/capability_detection_runtime.go): source import evidence still uses `isSourceFile(base) && containsAny(lower, signals.imports)`. Keep open until real import syntax is distinguished from prompts/comments/string literals with the listed negative and positive regressions.

---

## Bug

`baha app inspect` reports `database.document` as `suggested` for `baseharbor-demo` although the application does not use a document database.

Confirmed against v0.4.20 and still present on the active v0.4.21 release branch.

### Reproducer

`baseharbor-demo` commit `5e17de4dbf0050e7ab34398ac6e11fd8533f0365` contains:

```python
Rule(r"MongoDB-compatible document database instances ...", ...)
```

in `tests/guided/drive.py`.

The current source/import detector scans every source file with raw substring matching:

```go
if isSourceFile(base) && containsAny(lower, signals.imports)
```

so the string literal containing `MongoDB-compatible` becomes false `EvidenceImport`.

## Required behavior

Capability import evidence must come from actual import/require/reference syntax, not arbitrary prose, comments, prompts, regexes or string literals.

Test/E2E harness source must not imply production application capabilities merely because it contains provider/client names.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `MongoDB-compatible` prompt text does not suggest `database.document`.
- [ ] Real Python `import pymongo` / `from pymongo ...` is detected.
- [ ] Real Go imports such as mongo-driver/pgx remain detected.
- [ ] Real JS/TS import/require references remain detected.
- [ ] Comments and unrelated strings do not create import evidence.
- [ ] Existing dependency metadata detection remains unchanged.
- [ ] Source scanning remains bounded/read-only.
- [ ] Focused repositoryinspect tests + go vet pass.
- [ ] Fix is integrated into the active v0.4.21 release line.

Related source-neutral inspect fix: #750
Release work: #569
Semantic acceptance: #174
